Shim that delegates to the language-agnostic datpkgr kit.

datpkgr owns all version discovery, git operations and install bookkeeping. This module binds it to Clue's configuration (clueCfg) and re-exports the types that the rest of Clue expects, so call-sites do not need to thread DatpkgrConfig through every layer. For the canonical logic see ~/.clue/develop/datpkgr/src/datpkgr/versions.nim.

configs, nimbleparser
